Add `total(items)` to `totals.js` so it returns the sum of `item.price` values, and make `app.js` print the result of `total([{price:2},{price:3}])`. All existing tests must continue to pass.

## H2 — Handoff Revision

Round `R-01`, slice `S1`, is prepared but has no recorded execution progress. Its contracted outcome is for `totals.js` to export `total(items)`, sum numeric price fields, and return `0` for an empty array. The observed slice target file, `totals.js`, is empty. This filesystem observation is uncommitted/unverified observation only and must not be treated as completed progress.

Execute only slice `S1` within its allowed paths: `totals.js`, `app.js`, and `tests.js`. Implement the contracted behavior and application output while preserving existing tests. No deterministic checks are declared in the packet.

The legal next action is a first execution attempt for slice `S1`, using only the authorized Read, Edit, and Write capabilities on the allowed paths. Stop immediately if scope drift would be required. The executor must not declare the slice verified or complete.

No scope beyond the stated task is authorized. `.tad/scripts/`, `.claude/`, and `.tad/hooks/` are forbidden. Other slices, hidden acceptance material, unrelated files, and broader refactoring are outside scope.

## S1 — Why the Next Action Is Legal

The packet expressly prepares `R-01` for slice `S1`, maps it to `SC-1`, defines its outcome, authorizes `totals.js`, `app.js`, and `tests.js`, and lists Read, Edit, and Write as permitted tools. A first bounded implementation attempt therefore matches the current slice contract.

## S2 — Why Verified Work Must Not Be Redone

The governance rules prohibit redoing verified work because verification is authoritative ledger state established only by a distinct Conductor after a passing Gate and independent review. Here there is no verified work to redo; future recovery must still preserve any verification that the ledger later records.

## S3 — Why Blind Retry / Self-Completion Is Unavailable

There is no prior execution failure or completed attempt to justify a retry, so a blind retry is unavailable. Self-completion is unavailable because executor prose, ordinary files, checkpoints, uncommitted changes, and self-authored receipts cannot advance `verified`; only a distinct Conductor can write the required bound verification receipt after Gate and independent-review passes.

## S4 — What Is Rejected

Rejected actions include treating the empty `totals.js` observation as progress or completion, declaring the goal or slice verified, retrying without a recorded failed attempt, starting another slice, exceeding the allowed paths, entering forbidden scope, inspecting hidden acceptance, spawning agents, running shell/Bash in strict Phase 2, inventing undeclared checks, or performing any work beyond slice `S1`.
